mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT keep moving upward from their current depressed levels, commuting frequency will rise and spill over into nearby retail and recreation trips. When TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points from one week to the next, RETAIL_REC should weaken within one week and stay lower for the next month.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT is around -56 to -60 over the snapshot window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or remains unchanged over the next week after TRANSIT drops more than 5 points week-on-week.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve within 14 days after a two-week increase in PARKS mobility.
